scope: Static reconstruction of modern TCPs.TCPClient over Mirror. No game/client/server launch, connection, packet capture, or protocol execution test was performed for this analysis.
notation: Field indices are zero based AFTER ProcessorQueue removes opcode. C2S fields listed BEFORE AES.Encrypt globally appends '#' + platform enum NAME. S2C field lists describe client requirements, not proof of the retired server implementation.

transport.opcode: decimal Int32 in first decrypted token
transport.cipher: AES-128-ECB, PKCS7, UTF8 plaintext, standard Base64 ciphertext
transport.outer_framing: Mirror/Telepathy; see Mirror compatibility findings. # is an application delimiter, not a TCP packet boundary.

binary_converter_float.encode: float32 bits -> two UTF16 code units: low16, high16 on this little-endian build

transitive_findings.observed: Type6 uses HTTP identity-resolution callback rather than modern TCP26. Callback checks resolved psidglobal nonempty, then NETGcloudLogin.LoadSpace(psidglobal, empty noIdSpace, true, resolvedGuid, null). Empty psidglobal shows CannotConnectIsNotInSpace and clears pad lock.

Type2 passes notification.arguments to ManagerInstance.Send_AcceptFullGameNotification. Splits at first !, retains prefix through ! for EntryData.Deserialize, uses suffix to instantiate FullGameNETGCloud.OpenGameEntry subtype. Disconnect callback selects scene by FullGameManager.Type enum name, loads if absent, waits then calls FullGameManager.LaunchMultiScene(openGame). No modern TCP26 send in reviewed continuations; downstream FullGame/GCloud mode is a separate dependency.

Resolve guid through Memory; missing player ignored. Find existing PlayerCoffee(Clone) or PlayerOktoberFest(Clone) child. If absent, instantiate configured prefab under player transform and InitPlayerCoffee/InitPlayerOktoberFest(received count, player). Existing consumable refresh sets current times field0x18 to maximum field0x1c, ignoring new received count in that branch. Local player also receives drink/help UI. This packet equips/refills a consumable prop; it is not proof of account inventory persistence.

serverbound.behavior: SetCurrentAnim removes locomotion first, sets/loads local animation then sends4. Field1 is the metadata Int32 netId parameter. Seat/emote callers pass -1; RandomIdle.Initialize0x43e740 instead passes PlayerInfo.get_NetId0x616a70, preserving the UInt32 Mirror identity bits as signed Int32 decimal text. OnConnectedProcessor.OnAvatarLoaded0x5dfdc0 calls RandomIdle.Initialize at0x5e0223 before sending the stored C2S1 announcement at0x5e024f, so an own-netId animation can precede announcement. Preservation admission checks -1 or unchecked((int)peer.netId), retains GUID ownership validation and does not require announcement; this is a reconstruction policy, not proof of retired server rules. Names are joined with #. For no names, the final string field is empty after count0. Clientbound animation uses5 and omits field1.

direct_caller_audit.scope: Static scan of all executable-section E8 instructions targeting SetCurrentAnim0x5f4500; 22 direct calls, 21 passing0xffffffff and one passing the local Mirror netId. Indirect and inlined callers are not exhaustively established by this count.

direct_caller_audit.signed_conversion: The getter returns UInt32 in EAX; the caller writes those bits to the Int32 fifth parameter; SetCurrentAnim calls Int32.ToString. UInt32 values at or above0x80000000 therefore appear as negative decimal Int32 values.
